verification.method: scripts/verify/switzerland.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area; 8 million in 2013, 9 million in 2026
1.92 times 1950, the largest relative growth among European countries over 5 million; about 80% of 2000–2023 growth from net migration
Only declines 1975–1977, each with net emigration; natural loss from 2028 every year; fertility below 2.1 since 1971
Life expectancy highest in Europe (over 5 million), fourth worldwide after Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea; 1950 and 2100; peak 2051; 2100 slightly above today; median age
Capital status checked against the Swiss FDFA 'Political system' page (fetched 2026-11-25); urban share 1950/2026; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 63 of 63 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
